About us

Spices in a handy format

Spezie Clip offers spices, herbs and blends in resealable pouches with a clip, made for everyday cooking.

Every product comes in several weights, from 5 g at €0.99 up to 50 g, so you can try without buying more than you need. The label lists ingredients and allergens. If you have a question about a product or an order, write to us.

How we behave

1Clarity

Ingredients and allergens written on the label, with no promises we cannot verify.

2Practicality

Resealable pouches and weights from 5 to 50 g: take the right amount for your kitchen.

3Support

You write, we reply: before and after your purchase.
